name: Triage supplied public works notices
description: Read a customer-supplied CSV of public notice details, create a local weekly digest, and ask the owner to review it. No site access or outbound messages occur.
goal: Prepare a local, source-linked public works notice digest from official notice emails, customer-supplied official exports, or links the customer selected.

config.prompt: Your step: review the local weekly digest at $GLACIER_HOME/ventures/al-bid-triage/drafts/weekly-digest.md. Confirm that every source is official and that deadlines and addenda match the issuing authority. This approval records review only; Glacier does not send email, file bids, or contact agencies.
